What is Writesonic?

AI writing platform that has pivoted heavily toward SEO and AI-search visibility - it combines long-form article generation with keyword research, SERP analysis, internal linking and monitoring of how a brand appears in AI answer engines.

Best for

High-volume SEO content production with search-visibility tracking.

Main features

  • AI Article Writer with real-time SERP and competitor analysis
  • AI SEO agents for keyword clustering, content gap analysis and internal linking
  • GEO/AEO tracking (how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews)
  • Chatsonic research chatbot
  • Botsonic custom chatbot builder
  • bulk generation
  • WordPress publishing
  • brand voice.

Practical use cases

  • Producing SEO-optimised long-form articles at volume
  • auditing content gaps against competitors
  • tracking whether your brand is cited by AI answer engines
  • bulk-generating product descriptions
  • publishing straight to WordPress.

Who is it for?

  • SEO specialists, content marketers, agencies, affiliate publishers, small business owners.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium with credit/word-based subscription tiers

Plans described in the source

Free trial credits on signup. Individual/Lite tiers from roughly $16-20/mo billed annually. Standard around $79/mo, Professional around $199/mo, Advanced/Enterprise higher - all scaling by credits, seats and SEO agent capacity. Botsonic is priced separately. Verify - Writesonic restructures pricing very frequently and heavily discounts annual plans.

Free plan

Limited - free signup credits rather than a permanent free plan.

Free trial

Yes - free trial credits, no card required for basic signup.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered: article generation, SEO agent runs and image generation each consume different credit amounts. Seat counts and tracked-keyword volumes are tier-limited.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The GEO/AEO tracking - monitoring whether AI answer engines cite your brand - is a genuinely forward-looking feature few competitors offer
  • SERP-grounded article generation produces more competitive drafts than generic writing tools
  • aggressive pricing versus Jasper.

Limitations to consider

  • Feature sprawl - the product does many things adequately and few excellently
  • credit accounting is confusing and burns fast on SEO agents
  • output still needs substantial human editing to rank
  • frequent pricing changes and aggressive upsell prompts
  • support quality is inconsistent.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Chrome extension, WordPress plugin, API

Languages

  • 25+ languages including Arabic and French

API access

Yes - available on paid tiers

Integrations and exports

  • WordPress, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs/Semrush data, Zapier, Shopify, Surfer

Evaluation notes

Model your cost by credits consumed per article including SEO agent runs, not by the headline monthly price - this is where budgets overrun. Generated articles still need a human editor before publication.
